scope: Diagnostic qualification of inactive-writer observation overhead only; no retrieval-quality, production rollout, or provider parity claim.
control: Same candidate build, prepareRepositoryQualityContext with recordObservation false
candidate: Same candidate build, recordObservation true, selected event writer 1
fixture: One fixed initialized local repository, one 32 KiB Markdown candidate, one complete owner clause, no provider calls
coldDefinition: Fresh application process with no prior preparation; operating-system caches are not flushed
order: Alternate control/candidate and candidate/control within pairs
confidence: Paired percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, fixed xorshift32 seed 501, two-sided 95 percent interval
stopRules: Any changed semantic plan digest rejects the candidate
Any failed or cancelled process remains in the output and rejects qualification
Any privacy, unauthorized effect, stale-source success, or false evidence promotion stops rollout
measurementConditions: Shared developer workstation. This agent runs no builds, tests, package installation or knowledge scans during this single cohort. User and resident workloads remain running; CPU counters and load are observed, not controlled. OS caches are not flushed.
phaseProbeScope: Ten separate fresh-process diagnostics after the qualification cohort: core preparation without recording, structured clone of its exact report and bindings, then public writer-coordinate inspection. This is not a direct timer of the complete recording operation. Probe failures are retained and reject diagnostic completion.
cohortPolicy: One fixed 30 warm / 30 cold pair cohort, no adaptive retry or sample exclusion. Gates unchanged. No production optimization without measured phase evidence.
